note: Alberta Parks campground in William A. Switzer Provincial Park, on Hwy 40 north of Hinton. Loops A-G sit in mature forest near the highway; Lakeside Loop (L) is about 2 km away by Gregg Lake's day use, boat launch, dock and swim area, inside a belt of spruce. Loop L stays open in winter, unserviced and with limited facility and road maintenance. --Claude
summary: Read the Alberta Parks page (advisories Nov 5, 2026), shop and tear sheet: unserviced C$30 confirmed (power rates no longer on the page), 159 sites in loops A-G + L (shop), max 61 ft, 10 pull-throughs, water hookups in Loop A, flush/vault toilets, showers, dump, summer taps, store; reservable May 14 - Sep 7, Loop L FCFS in winter. Season (manual, year-round) matches. Lakeview -> not waterfront recommended; pin ~530 m off.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview - recommend not waterfront): only Lakeside Loop (L) is near the lake; loops A-G are ~2 km inland. On imagery Loop L's east-side pads (around 53.5333,-117.8048) are ~55-60 m from the shore through continuous spruce, and the shore itself is a shallow weed bed fringed with sedge. The shop tags none of the 38 Loop L sites 'Near Water' (its only Near Water tag in the park is Pine Bay Group). The page says 'one loop located right next to Gregg Lake'. No on-water (tree belt), and nothing shows a view through 55 m of spruce: per the unsure-goes-down rule, not waterfront.

PIN (53.52788,-117.81335): in unbroken forest between loops A-G and the lake. The page's directions point 53.52315,-117.81409 lies among loops A-G (~530 m S; individual pads hidden by canopy, loop roads visible). Recommend 53.52315,-117.81409 (A-G hold 121 of 159 sites; Loop L is ~1.3 km NE around 53.5333,-117.8050).
PHONE (stored empty): the page's only line is 'Information: 1-877-537-2757'; no 'Facility Operator' line. Recommend 1-877-537-2757 unless a park office number is preferred.
